open_points.subject: A16 rule 2 — token-list re-read failure handling
open_points.text: "A changed configuration that fails a check of the start makes every request refused..." and later "A re-read applies only the start checks of the tokens... Only the token list is taken from a re-read; every other field of the configuration changes only at a restart."
open_points.question: On token-list re-read, which start checks must pass before requests are accepted again: all start checks, or only token-specific parse/length/uniqueness checks?
options: Re-run all configuration start checks on each re-read and refuse all requests if any fail
Run only token-list checks on re-read; ignore other start checks until restart
open_points.default_guess: Run only token-list checks on re-read, because the rule explicitly narrows re-read scope to tokens.

open_points.subject: A03 rule 4 — randomness trap scope
open_points.text: "...and the module-level functions of `random`, `random.SystemRandom`, and `random.Random` called without a seed or with `None`; `random.Random(seed)` with an explicit seed stays usable."
open_points.question: Exactly which `random`/`SystemRandom`/`Random` call sites must be trapped to raise `sandbox_violation`?
options: Trap only constructors/seeding entry points, allow generated methods once seeded
Trap all randomness-producing APIs reachable via module-level and class instances unless explicitly seeded deterministic PRNG path is used
open_points.default_guess: Trap module-level random-producing functions and unseeded constructors; allow deterministic `random.Random(seed)` instance methods.

open_points.subject: A09 rules 3 and 5 — oversized non-2xx response handling
open_points.text: Rule 3: "A response is used only when its status is 2xx, its size is within `service_response_bytes_max`..."; Rule 5 maps oversized body only in the "status 2xx" row.
open_points.question: If status is 3xx/4xx/5xx and body exceeds `service_response_bytes_max`, which outcome applies?
options: Status class decides outcome regardless of body size (3xx/5xx/4xx mapping unchanged)
Exceeding `service_response_bytes_max` changes outcome to a transport failure class
open_points.default_guess: Keep status-class mapping unchanged for non-2xx and do not reinterpret oversized error bodies.
